name: classify-dispatch-flags
description: A dbt_project.yml with dispatch (which reroutes macro resolution to another package) and flags (which change dbt behaviour project-wide) confers authority rather than declaring.

payload.content:
name: things
version: '1.0'
profile: things
dispatch:
  - macro_namespace: dbt_utils
    search_order: [things, dbt_utils]
flags:
  require_explicit_package_overrides_for_builtin_materializations: false
